title: Battle of Kushtia
subtitle: Early armed resistance follows Operation Searchlight.
summary: The Battle of Kushtia was one of the early armed resistance episodes after Operation Searchlight. Local Bengali forces and civilians challenged Pakistani control before the war settled into longer sector-based fighting.
heroTagline: Early armed resistance follows Operation Searchlight.
whyItMatters: Kushtia shows how resistance began locally before becoming a structured liberation campaign.
